newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar edges up but trading dull.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar edges up but trading dull.

text.p: Price movements remained thin on London's white sugar market on Thursday with interest centred in the two nearby positions and no fresh fundamental news to spur activity, traders said.

Dealings were routine in the afternoon with switches and crosses cited in both the December and March contracts, which was the broad trading pattern of the morning, they said. At 1615 GMT December stood 70 cents higher at $318.90 and March up 80 cents at $316.00. Further forwards were slightly weaker but movements were again narrow.

Ranges were tight across the board at a maximum $2.00 despite a slightly firmer raws market dragging values off their earlier lows. Volume reached 1,214 lots. European brokers said Libya postponed the deadline for bids in its white sugar buying tender until Friday, with replies to be issued sometime on Monday. Libya has tendered to buy 14,000 tonnes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar for shipment in November/December.
Activity was subdued on the Paris market where volume amounted to 241 lots. December was 50 cents lower at $317.90 and March 60 cents up at $316.00.
